text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing.pipeline.token-aggregator latency exceeded threshold (p95 > 3s) — possible delayed usage emits / overage flags. Please acknowledge with `ack` and join thread.
Priya Nair: acked. I'm oncall — looking now.
Alex Carter: on it, checking consumer lag on kafka-topic `usage-events-v2`.
Jin Park: I'm seeing a spike in consumer lag on consumer-group `token-agg-cg` around 11:03 UTC, offsets behind by ~1.2M.
Priya Nair: Marcos, can you check recent billing emits? any customers seeing overage emails?
Marcos Ruiz: Looking at latest batch ETL -> the emit writer shows lots of retries and 500s to billing-ingest for last 9m. Some emits are queued. No broad customer emails yet but overage flags count increased by ~420 in last 15m.
Samir Patel: Sales pinged asking if there's any escalations from big customers, they're waiting. I'll standby for comms.
Alex Carter: quick run: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --describe --group token-agg-cg` -> lag by partition: 1.2M total, 8 partitions spiking.
Alex Carter: jumping to host to restart aggregator pod `token-aggregator-7b6d` and scale down/up to force rebalance.
Priya Nair: opsbot, temporarily mute alert rule `billing.pipeline.token-aggregator` for 20m to avoid noise while we triage?
opsbot: Alert muted for 20 minutes by Priya Nair. Reason: live mitigation.
Jin Park: Consumer restart didn't clear lag; offsets still stuck. I see `kconnect` errors in logs: `Commit failed: Coordinator not available` on multiple aggregator instances.
Alex Carter: seems like a-zookeeper flake? Checking broker list and zookeeper connection.
Marcos Ruiz: In parallel, I'm running a SQL rollup to compare emitted tokens vs raw events for the last 2 hours:
```
SELECT hour, SUM(raw_tokens) as raw, SUM(emitted_tokens) as emitted
FROM billing_rollups
WHERE source = 'usage-events' AND hour >= now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour DESC
```
Marcos Ruiz: Preliminary: emitted ~8% lower than raw for last 2 windows. That lines up with lag.
Priya Nair: Customer impact assessment: probable delayed usage reporting for some customers, temporary undercount leading to delayed overage flags (false negatives). Downstream billing totals currently under-reported.
Samir Patel: OK — if delays are bounded (minutes), we can avoid sending customer-level emails. If this stretches >1h, we need comms. I'll draft a status note contingent on duration.
Alex Carter: Found a problematic broker node (kafka-broker-3) with I/O spikes and disk pressure; kernel logs show `scsi: mmc_cmd_timeout`. We should cordon and drain that broker.
Jin Park: Reassigning partitions off broker-3 with `kafka-reassign-partitions` plan now. Will monitor ISR and under-replicated partitions.
incident-bot: Deployment note: `token-aggregator` version 1.3.2 was rolled at 10:45 UTC yesterday. No config changes since.
Priya Nair: Good catch. While partitions rebalance, we should enable short-term prefix cache for reads so live API users aren't affected. Can we flip a flag?
Alex Carter: I can toggle `ENABLE_PREFIX_KV_CACHE=true` via feature flag service for production routing. Doing it now.
Alex Carter: feature flag flipped. Observability: p95 latency for api/generate down to normal, but billing emits still delayed while consumer catches up.
Marcos Ruiz: Running backfill job plan: once consumer lag < 50k, we'll run `billing-backfill --window 2h --throttle 500/s` to replay missed events into emitter.
Priya Nair: Let's coordinate: Jin to confirm rebalance progress and when lag < 50k; Alex to stand by to restart backfill job; Marcos to validate rollups after backfill; Samir to hold comms draft until we confirm exposure.
Jin Park: Rebalance progressing. ISR restored on most partitions. Current total lag 340k and dropping. ETA ~9 minutes.
Samir Patel: Draft status: "We've detected an internal ingestion delay affecting billing telemetry; no customer invoices will be generated incorrectly at this time. We'll provide update within 30 minutes." Save until final.
Alex Carter: Lag now 48k. I'll kick off backfill (dry-run first).
Alex Carter: dry-run shows expected catch-up time ~7m at throttle 500/s. Starting live backfill.
Marcos Ruiz: Backfill started. Watching emitted token counts vs raw.
Marcos Ruiz: Emitted delta closing; rollups recomputing.
incident-bot: Backfill job id czb-114 queued -> running. Logs: `processed 12k events/min`
Jin Park: Consumer group stable, no more kconnect errors. Broker-3 has been cordoned and flagged for maintenance.
Alex Carter: Backfill complete. Emitted tokens now within 1% of raw for last 3 windows.
Marcos Ruiz: Verified. Running reconciliation script and pushing corrected aggregates to billing-write.
Priya Nair: Customer impact verdict: short delay (approx 40m) for some usage emits. No overbilling occurred; some customers briefly saw delayed usage visibility and temporary overage flag spike but flags reconciled; no action required for invoices.
Samir Patel: Sending comms to Sales/CS: "We had an ingestion delay causing delayed usage metrics for a subset of customers between 11:03–11:45 UTC. Counts have been reconciled and no billing impact observed. If customers ask, escalate to Priya."
Priya Nair: Ops followups: (1) schedule broker maintenance for kafka-broker-3; (2) add consumer-group p99 alerting and a secondary path to skip commits if coordinator unreachable; (3) run a small load test to exercise commit path under partition failover.
Alex Carter: I'll file infra tickets and drop the quick runbook notes in #eng-infra.
Marcos Ruiz: Also adding a one-off audit: run `billing.reconciliation --window 24h` overnight to ensure no residual drift.
opsbot: Alert muted period ended.
Priya Nair: Closing thread — will create a postmortem if anything surfaces overnight. Thanks all :heart:
